en.title: Export folder
en.intro: Cacaduu Upload sends the newest stock file from your export folder to cacaduu.com every 15 minutes. It only reads the folder.
en.sign_in_title: Sign in with your Cacaduu shop account
en.pick_folder: Choose the folder your stock software exports to (e.g. C:\Export).
en.signed_out: You are signed out. Sign in again.
en.folder_missing: The folder {folder} cannot be found. Choose it again.
en.no_file: No stock file in this folder yet (XML, CSV, TXT or XLSX).
en.settling: The newest file was written less than a minute ago. It is sent as soon as the export is finished.
en.up_to_date: The newest file has already been sent.
en.not_owner: This account may not upload stock for this shop.
en.send_failed: Sending failed: {error}. It tries again at the next check.
en.api_connected: The stock is updated through the connected inventory software – files are not uploaded now.
en.agent_connected: The stock is updated through the POS agent – files are not uploaded now.
en.sklad_active: The stock is kept in Stock in Cacaduu – files are not uploaded now.
en.result_updated: Stock sent. Items updated: {items}; set to out of stock (missing from the file): {zeroed}.
en.result_unchanged: This file had already been sent.
en.result_error: The file could not be read: {error}
en.result_proposed: File received (rows: {rows}). Now check its columns once on cacaduu.com under My shop → Stock file columns and approve them; after that your stock appears automatically.
en.result_waiting_for_approval: File received (rows: {rows}). Waiting for you to approve its columns on cacaduu.com under My shop.
en.result_layout_changed: The file’s layout has changed (rows: {rows}). Your previous stock stays visible until you approve the new columns on cacaduu.com under My shop.
en.no_shops: This account has no shop yet. Create one on cacaduu.com first.

sk.title: Priečinok s exportom
sk.intro: Cacaduu Upload každých 15 minút odošle najnovší súbor so zásobami z priečinka s exportom na cacaduu.com. Priečinok iba číta.
sk.pick_folder: Vyberte priečinok, do ktorého skladový program exportuje (napr. C:\Export).
sk.folder_missing: Priečinok {folder} sa nenašiel. Vyberte ho znova.
sk.no_file: V priečinku zatiaľ nie je súbor so zásobami (XML, CSV, TXT alebo XLSX).
sk.settling: Najnovší súbor bol zapísaný pred menej ako minútou. Odošle sa hneď, ako sa export dokončí.
sk.not_owner: Tento účet nemôže nahrávať zásoby tohto obchodu.
sk.send_failed: Odoslanie zlyhalo: {error}. Skúsi sa to znova pri ďalšej kontrole.
sk.api_connected: Sklad sa aktualizuje cez pripojený skladový program – súbory sa teraz nenahrávajú.
sk.agent_connected: Sklad sa aktualizuje cez POS agenta – súbory sa teraz nenahrávajú.
sk.sklad_active: Zásoba sa vedie v Sklade v Cacaduu – súbory sa teraz nenahrávajú.
sk.result_updated: Zásoby odoslané. Aktualizované položky: {items}; nastavené na vypredané (chýbajú v súbore): {zeroed}.
sk.result_proposed: Súbor prijatý (riadky: {rows}). Teraz raz skontrolujte jeho stĺpce na cacaduu.com v časti Môj obchod → Stĺpce súboru so zásobami a schváľte ich; potom sa zásoby zobrazia automaticky.
sk.result_waiting_for_approval: Súbor prijatý (riadky: {rows}). Čaká sa, kým schválite jeho stĺpce na cacaduu.com v časti Môj obchod.
sk.result_layout_changed: Rozloženie súboru sa zmenilo (riadky: {rows}). Doterajšie zásoby zostávajú viditeľné, kým neschválite nové stĺpce na cacaduu.com v časti Môj obchod.
sk.no_shops: Tento účet zatiaľ nemá obchod. Najprv ho vytvorte na cacaduu.com.
